headline: Argentina fans celebrate in Dhaka ahead of World Cup matches
summary: Argentina fans celebrated in Dhaka, displaying their enthusiasm for the World Cup with a vibrant parade.
details: The excitement surrounding the football World Cup is at an all-time high in Bangladesh. Supporters of Argentina took to the streets in the Helipad area of East Dhaka, parading in anticipation of their team's title defense.

The event featured a vibrant display of blue and white, showcasing the fans' passion and love for their team. The atmosphere was filled with enthusiasm and emotion as supporters celebrated their national pride.

This gathering is just one of many across the country, highlighting the widespread support for Argentina as they aim to retain their championship title. Fans are united in their hopes and dreams for the upcoming matches.
caption:
Argentina supporters filled the streets of Dhaka, showcasing their passion for the World Cup!

The excitement surrounding the football World Cup is at an all-time high in Bangladesh. Supporters of Argentina took to the streets in the Helipad area of East Dhaka, parading in anticipation of their team's title defense.

The event featured a vibrant display of blue and white, showcasing the fans' passion and love for their team. The atmosphere was filled with enthusiasm and emotion as supporters celebrated their national pride.

This gathering is just one of many across the country, highlighting the widespread support for Argentina as they aim to retain their championship title. Fans are united in their hopes and dreams for the upcoming matches.

#WorldCup #Argentina #Football #Bangladesh #Sports

Source: Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV, Somoy News
